name: ui-disconnect-only
summary: Stock client disconnect to the main menu: poll `disconnect` `statusOnly` until a leftover leave latch is cleared, request the leave (`requested: true`), wait until ping has no Client_0, then wait for the inventory-cleared handshake. Does not reconnect.
notes: Acceptance procedure — not run. `--side client`. Start connected (`world: any` records whichever world is detected). A previous connect/disconnect can leave `LeaveGamePolicy` latched: poll `disconnect` `statusOnly:true` first. `state: superseded` (replacement `Client_0`) or leftover `pending` without this leave having been requested is not a new request — observing `superseded` clears `_requested`; keep polling until `requested` is false and `state` is not `superseded`, then mutate. Envelope `ok` is not proof of leaving.

`disconnect` without `statusOnly` then requests the production ExitGame view. Assert `requested: true` and `state` not `superseded` (pending is not completion). Poll client ping until worlds has no Client_0.

Handshake wait: client Core line `Mods inventory: server context cleared reason=disconnect` (`inventoryCleared`, sinceRecord on the disconnect op), then mods_ui status closed (`after.open` false, `after.modsCapture` false) and `after.serverList.state` unavailable.
Does not `connect`. Rejoin is `ui-reconnect-only`. `endWorld: main-menu` so final checks match the menu, not the connected start.
Intended finals: no Client_0, workspace closed, curtain/input released.

steps.name: inventory cleared after disconnect
steps.regex: Mods inventory: server context cleared reason=disconnect
